title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Mobile Developer (iOS & Android – Native)
Location: Remote – Latin America Preferred
Type of Contract: Full-Time | Contractor
Salary Range: Market Rates
Language Requirements: English (Professional Working Proficiency)

We are seeking a skilled Senior Mobile Developer with deep experience building native iOS and Android applications to join our growing team. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and shipping production-grade mobile apps with real-time communication and secure integrations. Your work will directly impact mobile performance, reliability, and the end-user experience across voice, messaging, and data-driven workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain native iOS applications using Swift and Xcode.

  • Build and maintain native Android applications using Kotlin and Android Studio.

  • Integrate and manage Twilio SDKs for voice, messaging, and real-time events.

  • Consume and integrate Laravel-based REST APIs for authentication, data, and workflows.

  • Implement secure authentication flows using JWT and OAuth patterns.

  • Handle push notifications, background services, and full mobile app lifecycle events.

  • Own mobile quality end to end, including performance optimization, testing, and App Store / Play Store releases.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6 years of professional mobile development experience.

  • Proven production experience with native iOS and native Android applications.

  • Hands-on experience integrating Twilio SDKs in mobile apps.

  • Strong experience consuming REST APIs, ideally built with Laravel.

  • Solid understanding of mobile networking, asynchronous flows, and error handling.

  • Experience implementing mobile security best practices.

  • Strong debugging, profiling, and performance optimization skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building real-time voice, calling, or communication-focused applications.

  • Experience with WebSockets or event-driven mobile architectures.

  • Experience collaborating closely with backend teams on API contracts.

  • Exposure to or frontend concepts for cross-team collaboration.

  • Experience scaling mobile apps with high traffic or real-time usage.

Tech Stack

  • iOS: Swift, Xcode

  • Android: Kotlin, Android Studio

  • Mobile SDKs: Twilio

  • Backend APIs: Laravel REST APIs

  • Authentication: JWT, OAuth

  • Tooling: Git, CI/CD pipelines, App Store Connect, Google Play Console

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:

At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.
We're looking for practitioners who understand vulnerabilities, exposure management, and remediation in real environments. You'll work with real-world data and scenarios that reflect how security teams actually discover, prioritize, and fix risk across modern systems.
Organization: Alignerr Position: Vulnerability Management Analyst Type: Contract / Task-Based Compensation: $35–$60 /hour Location: Remote Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

Analyze vulnerability reports, CVEs, and exposure scenarios across infrastructure and applications
Classify severity, impact, exploitability, and remediation strategies
Review patching, mitigation, and remediation decision-making scenarios
Help generate, label, and validate realistic security-reasoning data used to evaluate and improve AI systems
What We're Looking For
2+ years in vulnerability management, security operations, or infrastructure security
Familiar with CVEs, scanners, patching workflows, and risk prioritization frameworks
Understand the tradeoffs between theoretical risk and what actually matters in production
A clear, structured, and analytical thinker
Why Join Us
Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
Work directly on frontier AI systems.
Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
Potential for contract extension.

Submit your resume
Complete a short screening
Project matching and onboarding

title: Auxiliar Mecânico de Refrigeração
description:
Execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos de climatização, abrangendo atividades como limpeza técnica, reapertos, inspeções de funcionamento, medições elétricas e termodinâmicas, identificação e substituição de componentes defeituosos (compressores, placas eletrônicas, sensores, válvulas, ventiladores, entre outros). Orçam serviços e elaboram documentação técnica. Especificam materiais, executam rotinas estabelecidas pelo Encarregado/Coordenador de Manutenção e Supervisores, e fornecem feedbacks sobre o andamento dos serviços. Ensino médio completo e curso profissionalizante em Mecânica de Refrigeração, sendo desejável formação técnica em Refrigeração. É imprescindível possuir certificação específica em sistemas VRF (tais como LG, Daikin, Fujitsu, Midea ou similares), bem como experiência comprovada na manutenção de sistemas de climatização do tipo VRF, Fancoil, Split, AC e Chiller. title: Network Engineer II
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
The Network Engineer II utilizes multiple technologies (Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper, and Extreme) to support a large university network infrastructure. Installs, sets up, and monitors the local area network ( LAN ), Wide Area Network ( WAN ) and wireless network (Wi-Fi). The Network Engineer II also performs a variety of maintenance, evaluation, installation, and training tasks to ensure LAN performance meets university and user requirements.
Supervisory Accountability
Responsible for orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a "lead" or "senior" capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include department's management in pursuit of quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement on the goals to meet needs dictated by the department. External contacts may include customers, vendors and the general public.
Principal Accountabilities
Perform network design and solutions architecture of small to large enterprise networks.
Possess experience with enterprise routing, switching, WiFi and security solutions.
Perform networking and security troubleshooting
Perform troubleshooting of GPON network systems
Perform troubleshooting of Avaya telecommunications systems
Installing, configure, and maintain network, network security, and VoIP systems.
Utilize excellent oral and written communication skills, be a team leader and be willing to learn.
Serve as technical project lead for network infrastructure projects and incidents.
Serve as technical liaison for all third-party IT vendors
Stays informed of new developments and technologies.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
Working knowledge and experience in local and wide area networking, communications, and related hardware and software.
Working knowledge of wired and wireless networks, connections, wiring and cabling standards, and network management tools and processes.
Strong interpersonal skills as well as strong oral and written communication skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with all internal customers.
Ability to document moderate to complex technical issues, effectively summarizing issues for a range of technical and business clients.
Ability to schedule and prioritize work load to accommodate customer needs while minimizing impact on current projects and network availability.
Ability to perform routine duties independently.
Ability to use analytical skills and consult with existing documentation to troubleshoot moderately complex issues affecting networks, systems, and applications.
Knowledge of standard project management methodologies and project life cycle phases.
Ability to gather user requirements, to complete systems analysis, and to create general systems design.
Ability to analyze and evaluate technical requirements and specifications.
Ability to identify key milestones for medium-sized projects, and to create project plans.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree desired in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related technical experience. At least five (4) years of experience and/or certifications in one or more of the following technologies: Cisco Systems; Aruba Wireless; Extreme Wireless; Cisco Wireless; Cisco Meraki. Excellent knowledge of TCP/IP, routing and switching. Good oral and written communication skills. Excellent customer service skills. Preferred Knowledge/Experience: General Windows skills. Physical Requirements: Ability to perform network hardware installation which could include lifting, moving, and installing equipment up to 50 lbs.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$70,000-$80,000

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Company Overview:
If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you're searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve's position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone
Role Summary:
Responsible for ensuring Supplier Quality, conducting process and product audits, part qualifications (PPAP/APQP), and managing nonconformance reports (NCR), including containment, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions. Act proactively to drive continuous improvement, ensuring compliance with Flowserve standards and monitoring supplier KPIs.
Responsibilities:
Conduct process and product audits at suppliers to verify compliance with Flowserve requirements.
Lead corrective and preventive action plans (containment, root cause, 8D, A3).
Manage part and process qualification (PPAP, APQP, FAI, Control Plan).
Support resolution of customer complaint/escape issues (RCA/CA).
Monitor supplier KPIs (nonconformities, rework, scrap, First Pass Yield).
Update and maintain internal platforms (AVL, SCAR, CAPA).
Promote a continuous improvement culture and reduce cost of poor quality.
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001:2015 and safety requirements.
Availability for national and international travel (up to 50%).
Other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Production, or Industrial).
3–5 years of experience in Supplier Quality or related areas.
Experience in audits (Lead Auditor not required, but proven experience).
Advanced English (business communication and reporting).
Experience with PPAP, APQP, FAI, GD&T, and Control Plan.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Proactive profile with strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Experience / Skills:
Intermediate Spanish.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
Experience with quality software systems.
Knowledge of quality tools (FMEA, Ishikawa, 5 Whys, PDCA).
Strong organizational and planning skills.
Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.
Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Experiência em atendimento a clientes em lojas de varejo;

O QUE PODE SER UM DIFERENCIAL?

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.
VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL
Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza
Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.
Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.
Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.
Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance
description:
Fresenius Medical Care is the world's leading provider of products and services for individuals with renal diseases of which around 3.9 million patients worldwide regularly undergo dialysis treatment. We care for more than 344,000 dialysis patients and provide our products in around 150 countries. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, we have consistently achieved remarkable growth and established ourselves as a trusted brand in the dialysis market.
PURPOSE AND SCOPE:
As a (Junior) Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d), you will contribute to the legal backbone of Fresenius Medical Care's global trade operations. In this role, you will provide legal guidance on customs and export control matters, support the development of compliant and cost-efficient supply chains, and help integrate trade governance into our global processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to international trade laws and internal policies, while driving continuous improvement and automation in trade-related legal frameworks. This is an exciting opportunity to grow within a dynamic legal environment and make a meaningful impact on global healthcare logistics.
Principal Duties And Responsibilities
Provide legal advice, counsel and guidance and on a range of trade governance matters such as customs and export controls, free trade agreements, special customs regimes and related risk management issues.
Ensure that FME and affiliates operate globally in accordance with applicable trade governance laws and regulations, as well as applicable and relevant internal policies.
Support and advise on the development and optimization of supply chains and flows of goods to achieve cost optimization in accordance with global trade laws.
Support the integration and automation of trade governance processes into FME's global operations and processes from a legal perspective.
Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Global Standard Operating Procedures (GSOPs) for customs and export controls, providing legal guidance and review in collaboration with stakeholders.
Continuous review of customs and export controls legislation and its applicability to FME business models and transactions.
Legal support and guidance in customs broker engagement and performance reviews.
Collaboration with stakeholders and the Customs and Export Controls Governance team for assessing training needs.
Support global development and customization of trainings to FME professionals involved in trade-related activities.
Support the coordination of global support for handling trade authorities' audits, reviews and challenges.
Support in the development for automation of trade-related processes and activities.
EDUCATION:
Fully qualified lawyer, incl. above-average university degree.
EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:
At least 2 years of relevant experience in customs and export controls in an international law firm and/or in-house legal department of an internationally operating and complex corporation, specializing in customs and export control matters.
Preferred Master's degree or equivalent.
Experience in roll-out and implementation of customs and export control policies, processes and trainings.
Ideally, experience in the healthcare sector.
Technical Skills
Good knowledge of global trade, including customs, and export control laws and regulations.
Knowledge of relevant commercial, tax and supply chain processes.
Ability to understand and apply regulatory requirements to business operations.
Experience with relevant trade compliance tools or willingness to learn.
Excellent written and spoken English, additional languages highly welcome.
Soft Skills
Innovation Mindset: embrace use of technology, automation and data analytics.
Ability to work autonomously and to remotely.
Ability to interpret complex customs and export control laws and regulations and apply them to real-world situations.
Ability to deal with ambiguity, complexity and conflicting priorities, whilst keeping a focus on main drivers.
Sound legal judgment under time pressure, balancing legal risk with business goals.
Global mindset and cultural sensitivity, with the ability to work effectively across regions and time zones.
Humor, highest professionalism for Fresenius Medical Care combined with self-modesty.
Distinct and highly committed team-player.
Team player with strong and effective communication and relationship skills.
High ethical standards and professionalism.
High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Willingness to travel.

Job Description
As an Engineer – End Fitting R&D, you will play a key role in enhancing, consolidating, and developing cutting-edge solutions for flexible pipe end-fittings. You will be the primary point of contact for ERD on assigned projects, reporting to the Manager of End Fitting Research & Development and collaborate cross-functionally with global teams, test facilities, and factories. Define and oversee test activities and dissections of test End Fittings and field samples
Collaborate with external certification bodies for certification of new technology
Develop design methodologies and guidelines, and support implementation into our design tools to enable safe and efficient execution of commercial projects
Collaborate closely with our End Fitting Supply team, providing R&D support during tendering and on commercial projects
Conduct structured root cause analyses in coordination with clients

M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent with a strong solid mechanics background
Experience in a similar role, within R&D, working with development and qualification of advanced products and technology
Proficiency in Finite Element modeling
Proven ability to plan and lead test programs
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Natural drive for engineering excellence
Commitment to HSE practices
Desired Qualifications
Experience in offshore oil & gas equipment engineering
Accustomed to working within a matrix organization
Enjoyment of team collaboration and social engagement
Soft Skills
To thrive in our culture, we value individuals who combine technical rigor with collaborative energy. You should be proactive, eager to engage across cultures, and excited by technical complexity.

title: Local Mobiliser
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Local Mobiliser reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.
Work LocationMauá (SP), Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. The Periferia Viva Program was launched by the Federal Government as part of the New Growth Acceleration Program for Favela Urbanization. The objective of the Program is to coordinate public policies and strengthen grassroots initiatives in peripheral territories, aiming to improve living conditions, particularly in the program's key areas: urban infrastructure, social facilities, social and community empowerment, innovation, technology, and opportunities. The chosen territory for intervention in Mauá is part of "Chafick-Macuco". A settlement that emerged on unplanned, undeveloped land and now has about 26,835 residents. Though mostly residential, it lacks basic services: the streets are unpaved with no drainage, there's no public water or sewage system, and no proper community facilities or public spaces. The Periferia Viva – Jardim Zaíra/Chafick-Macuco project presents a set of interventions to support the Mauá City Hall, through the Municipal Housing Department, in implementing the Periferia Viva Program in Jardim Zaíra/Chafick-Macuco. To properly implement the Periferia Viva – Jardim Zaíra/Chafick-Macuco project, a Local Mobiliser is required. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Local Mobiliser reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Local Mobiliser will support the implementation of the programme and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Promote the participation and engagement of people living in the community; b) Support the organization and holding of meetings, workshops, assemblies and other spaces for social participation in the community; c) Clearly and efficiently communicate project information to the community, ensuring that everyone is aware of project activities; d) Promote active community participation in decision-making and project implementation, strengthening the sense of belonging; e) Publicize the programme in the communities; f) Attend project meetings whenever called upon; g) Participate in local meetings as requested; h) Ensure that the technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of the Agency and the counterparts; i) Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor; j) Elaborate and deliver a Monthly Activity Report in a timely manner. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Local Mobiliser will support the implementation of the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
High School diploma is required, or additional two (2) years of relevant technical experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
Minimum four (4) years of experience in social mobilization activities, or social work in slums and urban communities, work in community organization, and related areas in Brazil is required .
Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable. Skills:
Good computer skills in Windows and Office packages and Web search engines are required. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.

Work deeply with Claude Code to generate, debug, and refine production-ready code
Debug, clean up, and harden AI-generated code across the stack
Design and evolve human-in-the-loop workflows to ensure AI outputs meet quality standards
Improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability
Collaborate on platform architecture and long-term technical direction

Strong hands-on experience with Claude Code and AI-assisted development
Experience building and customizing Claude workflows (agents, prompts, skills, MDs)
Solid full-stack development skills, with confidence debugging backend-heavy systems
Background in data analysis, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
Clear understanding of AI capabilities and limitations in production systems
Comfortable owning a backend system that supports human-in-the-loop validation
Self-directed, detail-oriented, and proactive
Strong communication skills and comfort working independently in a remote environment

About the project:
At Nearsure, we know great talent doesn't wait for job openings. That's why we're building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.
These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.
With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.
As a Salesforce Senior Solution Architect, you will lead the technical vision for complex Salesforce programs, working directly with customers to understand their business goals, architect solutions that deliver measurable outcomes, and ensure those solutions are successfully implemented.
How your day-to-day work will look like:
Own the architecture for Salesforce solutions from inception through delivery, ensuring they meet business goals and deliver measurable value.
Architect scalable and sustainable Salesforce solutions that support business processes and integrate with other systems.
Provide end-to-end technical guidance and leadership throughout the Salesforce implementation lifecycle.
Leverage Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and other Salesforce products to design customized solutions.
Collaborate with development teams to implement custom Salesforce solutions using APEX, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and integrations.
Review and ensure adherence to best practices in Salesforce development and deployment, including code reviews and performance optimization.
Act as a subject matter expert (SME) to guide business and technical teams on Salesforce features, updates, and capabilities.
Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and stakeholders, influencing technical direction and business priorities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and other architects, to translate business requirements into actionable Salesforce solutions.
Engage with key business stakeholders to understand their goals and objectives, advising on how Salesforce capabilities can be leveraged to meet these goals.
Design integrations between Salesforce and third-party applications using APIs, middleware, and data migration strategies.
Develop custom solutions and workflows using Salesforce technologies, ensuring the seamless integration of Salesforce with existing enterprise systems.
Maintain Salesforce architectural standards and best practices, including security, data management, and performance optimization.
Lead efforts in Salesforce governance, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security protocols.
Stay updated on Salesforce releases and emerging best practices to continuously improve the organization's Salesforce environment.
Mentor junior architects, developers, and Salesforce administrators, providing guidance and technical oversight.
Lead technical workshops, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to foster a culture of continuous learning.
This would make you the ideal candidate:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ Years of experience working with Salesforce in an Architect or Senior Developer role.
Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Platform.
Proficiency with Salesforce Lightning, APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components.
Strong experience with Salesforce integrations (APIs, web services, middleware).
Expertise in data modeling, data migration, and data integration.
Salesforce Architect certifications (e.g., Technical Architect, Application Architect).
Experience in Agile methodologies and project management practices.
Experience leading large-scale Salesforce implementations and managing teams.
Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Contact: Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
Knowing you better: We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.

Transparency: This process is direct and without intermediaries.
At Nearsure, we're dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team

Let's work together to shape the future of technology

Nosso compromisso vai além da entrega de serviços de alta qualidade nas áreas de auditoria, contabilidade e consultoria tributária, contábil e financeira. Somos também uma Empresa Cidadã, que acredita e pratica o equilíbrio entre a vida pessoal e profissional, refletido em ações concretas, como a extensão da licença-maternidade e paternidade.
Na MCS Markup, o trabalho é mais do que cumprir tarefas; é uma jornada de crescimento e aprendizado constante. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza seu desenvolvimento, que enxerga além dos números e busca impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas, então seu lugar é aqui.

Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.

title: Assistant Registrar, Records
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students.
This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.
Supervisory Authority
Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.
Principal Accountabilities
Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including, but not limited to, registration permissions, overrides, waitlist and batch registration.
Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
Produces academic standing and Deans list reports for review by the Provost's Office and
various schools and colleges.
Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
Develops and delivers point-of-use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account
Core Competencies
Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e. Banner, Colleague, Workday).
Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
Detail-oriented and customer service and compliance-focused.
Proven record of accountability and follow-through.
Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar's office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

title: Equipment Inspector
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.
Reports To
Maintenance Superintendent offshore.
Functional relationship with equipment inspection coordinator onshore.
Background
The Equipment Inspector will exhibit high level of knowledge in equipment inspection of boiler, pressure vessels, related systems and accessories. They manage common interfaces that arise in day-to-day operations with the FPSO departments' staff liaising with the Maintenance Superintendent onboard and with the Equipment Inspector Coordinator onshore.
Authority
The Equipment Inspector undertakes regulatory compliance inspections in pressure vessels systems and related instruments / equipments.
Immediate Subordinates
Visitors, subcontractors
Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards
1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
1 Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
2 Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
3 Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
2) Works
1 Conduct internal and external equipment inspection as well as hydro test as required by the regulation.
2 Ensure full compliance with SPIE regulation.
3 Keep all inspection and equipments data book updated.
4 Produce reports of the equipment inspection and its data book.
5 Follow external audits and reports to the Maintenance Superintendent and to the Equipment Inspector Coordinator the status of the audit.
6 Coordination of the subcontractors work on board the unit in regard to the SPIE equipments.
3) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
1 Work area within own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
1 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines.
2 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure.
5) Emergency Response
1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.
Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies
Offshore - Handover
Offshore - Emergency Response
Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge
Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System
Offshore - Reports
Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding
Offshore - Planning Work
Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment
Offshore - Safety Management
Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience
Experience as Equipment Inspector and qualified to Equipment Inspection Course.
Proven qualification on NDT and welding.
Experience and knowledge in offshore operation is desirable.
Computer literate on Management System 'Office' software packages.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 5 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 6 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work.
Pois é, essa empresa existe. Essa empresa é a IPNET by Vivo
Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.
E, estamos com uma vaga aberta para Desenvolvedor Pleno, com foco em N8N (Automações e Agentes de IA), que irá atuar dentro do nosso time de Delivery Team, sendo responsável por:
Desenvolver, configurar e monitorar integrações entre sistemas, com foco principal na plataforma N8N.
Estudar e documentar APIs de terceiros para viabilizar e estruturar integrações eficazes.
Implementar integrações utilizando n8n, e quando necessário, criar scripts customizados em Typescript ou similar) para automações e manipulações de dados mais complexas.
Trabalhar com modelos de LLM e ferramentas de IA conversacional, aplicando-os em fluxos de automação e integração.
Utilizar modelos de TTS (Text-to-Speech) e STT (Speech-to-Text) em aplicações com interfaces de voz.
Documentar os fluxos de integração, incluindo o mapeamento de processos, requisitos técnicos e identificação de pontos críticos.
Entendemos que para atender as demandas da vaga, é necessário que o candidato possua:
Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da computação, Engenharia da Computação e afins;
Experiência prática com modelos de LLM e ferramentas de IA conversasional;
Conhecimento técnico e experiência com modelos de TTS e STT, bem como ferramentas de voz;
Experiência comprovada em integração de sistemas via APIs REST;
Vivência com ferramentas de automação low-code/no-code, com destaque para n8n (e desejável experiência com outras como Zapier, Make/Integromat ou );
Habilidade em desenvolvimento com Typescript e (ou tecnologias similares).
Na IPNET by Vivo, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Por essa razão, nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil: um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Cidade Monções/Sede Eco Berrini).

description:
AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.
VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA EXPANSAO SR NA YDUQS.
Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.
Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.
Venha fazer parte desse time
VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA EXPANSAO SR são:
Desenvolver e manter modelos geoespaciais para identificação das melhores localizações para abertura de novas unidades, considerando variáveis demográficas, socioeconômicas, concorrência e potencial de mercado;
Conduzir análises territoriais por cidade/região, incluindo definição de áreas de influência (catchment área), mapas de calor, clusterização geográfica e estudos de densidade;
Integrar dados internos e externos (ex.: IBGE, bases públicas, dados de mercado, concorrência e performance histórica) para geração de indicadores de decisão;
Apoiar as áreas de expansão, franquias e estratégia com análises baseadas em location intelligence;
Estruturar critérios e score de priorização geográfica para expansão da rede;
Elaborar relatórios, dashboards e apresentações executivas com recomendações de localização;
Atuar de forma colaborativa com stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento entre dados, estratégia e decisão de negócio;
Documentar metodologias, premissas e modelos utilizados, assegurando reprodutibilidade e governança analítica.
Requisitos e qualificações
Buscamos profissionais com:
Formação superior completa em áreas como Geografia, Estatística, Engenharia, Economia, Ciência de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas;
Experiência profissional com geomarketing, geoprocessamento ou inteligência geográfica aplicada a negócios;
Conhecimento sólido em GIS (QGIS, ArcGIS, PostGIS ou equivalentes);
Experiência com modelagem de dados e análise estatística, preferencialmente utilizando Python ou R;
Vivência com análise territorial, potencial de mercado, expansão, varejo ou franquias;
Capacidade de trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e integrá-los a análises espaciais;
Conhecimento avançado em Excel e/ou ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
Perfil analítico, estruturado e com boa capacidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio.

title: AI Conversation Designer
description:
Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido
Localidades: São Paulo (SP), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e Florianópolis (SC)
Quem é Stone Tech?
Na Stone, a tecnologia e a inovação são pilares fundamentais. Estamos em uma jornada de transformação para nos tornarmos uma companhia "AI-driven", onde a inteligência artificial não é apenas uma ferramenta, mas uma parte intrínseca de nossa cultura, processos e produtos. O time de Design Conversacional atua como um agente dessa transformação, garantindo que as experiências com IA e interfaces de conversação sejam eficazes, escaláveis e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.
Nossa Cultura
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
AI Conversation Designer (Especialista)
O Desafio
Você Atuará Como Especialista, Com Alto Grau De Autonomia e Responsabilidade Técnica. Sua Missão é Traduzir Necessidades De Negócio Em Experiências Conversacionais Escaláveis e Sustentáveis, Equilibrando Profundidade Técnica e Amplitude De Atuação. Esta Função é Crítica Para Garantir a Coerência e o Amadurecimento Técnico Das Soluções De Conversation AI Em Múltiplos Projetos Simultaneamente.O Que Não Pode Faltar
Domínio do contexto técnico e estratégico do Design Conversacional para atuar com autonomia.
Habilidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos sem escopo pré-definido, exigindo priorização difícil e equilibrando prazo e qualidade.
Experiência em arquitetura de fluxos e desenho de jornadas multicanal.
Comunicação clara e colaborativa, atuando como referência para tomada de decisões e auxiliando a equipe a resolver problemas.
Familiaridade com conteúdo e linguagem escrita, compreender princípios básicos de gramática, construção de frases e clareza textual.
O Que Nós Esperamos De Você
Arquitetura e escala: Você irá arquitetar fluxos complexos e jornadas multicanal, traduzindo necessidades de negócio e insights de usuário em experiências conversacionais escaláveis e sustentáveis.
Design e qualidade: Você será responsável por garantir a coerência técnica e o uso consistente de tom e linguagem da marca, aplicando guidelines de comunicação e revisando entregas de outros Designers Conversacionais.
IA e colaboração: Você irá conectar as áreas de Produto, Engenharia e Dados para garantir a qualidade, padrão e eficiência das experiências com IA, colaborando para definir soluções viáveis e escaláveis.
Melhoria contínua: Você irá influenciar a definição de métricas, acompanhar a performance, mapear oportunidades de melhoria a partir de dados e feedbacks, e conduzir análises para propor ajustes estruturais nos fluxos.
Liderança técnica e governança: Você irá criar e manter frameworks e guidelines de design conversacional, garantindo a governança de conteúdo, a rastreabilidade e o aprendizado contínuo, além de disseminar conhecimento técnico (Mentoria técnica e promoção de boas práticas) no time.

title: Agente Comercial II
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.
Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atualizar de cadastros comerciais e técnicos;
Realizar atendimento ao usuário quando solicitado;
Entregar faturas e informativos;
Realizar o repasse de leitura;
Realizar parcelamentos de débitos;
Realizar entrega de A.R. referentes às notificações por irregularidade;
Realizar coleta de leitura e releitura dos hidrômetros, fiscalizar ligações e realizar corte e religação de água, com objetivo de apurar o consumo mensal de cada unidade consumidora e manter o relacionamento com o cliente;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas às descritas acima a critério da organização, de acordo com orientação do superior imediato.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Médio Completo;
CNH B;
Vivência com atendimento ao público, negociações, relacionamento com o cliente, parcelamentos, faturas e serviços comerciais.
Será um diferencial ter atuado em concessões de saneamento.
Fácil acesso a base de Engenho de Dentro.

Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Seguro de vida;

Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental;

Empréstimo consignado em folha;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.
#Rio
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta
A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Are you passionate about social media and excited about adapting global content to local audiences? Do you enjoy short-form video, feel comfortable on camera, and love turning ideas into engaging posts, stories, and videos?
At Metricool, we're looking for a Social Media Manager & Content Creator to own and manage our social media presence in Brazil, one of our most strategic growth markets.
You'll work 100% remotely in an international, fast-growing company, with a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and analytical thinking.
Your mission is to make Metricool relevant and recognizable in Brazil through social media. You'll do this by adapting and publishing global content for the local market, managing our day-to-day social media presence, and creating video-first content that reflects Brazilian culture and trends.
In this position, you will have a meaningful impact in different areas:
As Content Creator,
Adapt global social media campaigns, launches, and evergreen content to the Brazilian market, ensuring cultural relevance and a local tone.
Research and propose native content ideas based on Brazilian social media trends, memes, creator formats, and platform-specific behaviors.
Write and adapt captions in Brazilian Portuguese, aligned with Metricool's brand voice and messaging guidelines.
Act as a brand representative on camera, recording educational, promotional, and trend-based content.
Record short-form video content (TikTok & Instagram Reels) on a weekly basis.
Create occasional long-form video content (tutorials, feature explanations, or campaign support).
As Social Media Manager,
Manage and grow Metricool's Brazilian social media channels, mainly Instagram and LinkedIn.
Schedule and publish content according to the local content calendar.
Monitor performance and identify which formats, topics, and narratives resonate most with the Brazilian audience.
Engage with the community by responding to comments and relevant interactions when needed.
Share insights, trends, and performance learnings with the global marketing team to inform experimentation and strategy.
Long story, short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?
First month: For the first few weeks, we will ensure you understand your impact on the team and the business and learn about the team, the industry, and processes. You will meet every contributor on your team and understand their areas of expertise.
First Quarter: Within the first three months, you will understand your team better, work autonomously, and begin sharing new ideas and creating a more significant impact.
To the moon: After this process, you will become an active team member. You will also understand how to reach objectives and set your strategies based on the company's goals.
Job requirements. You'll be successful on your mission if you have:
Must be located in Brazil.
Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in a Social Media Management & Content Creation role.
Education: Degree in Digital Marketing or a similar field.
Languages: Native Portuguese , advanced level in English. Advanced level in Spanish is a plus.
Hard skills:
Strong experience managing social media accounts professionally.
Proven experience creating short-form, mobile-first video content.
Strong understanding of Brazilian social media culture, trends and creators ecosystems.
Soft skills:
Strong storytelling and on-camera presence.
Creative mindset with a strong sense of cultural relevance.
Ability to translate global brand messaging into local content.
Proactivity, autonomy, and ownership.
Flexibility and willingness to experiment and iterate.
Why will you fall in love with Metricool?
Remote Work Environment: Team members have the flexibility to work from any location of their choice. All processes are designed to accommodate remote work, fostering inclusivity and communication through platforms like Slack or Meets.
Annual Meetups: Once a year, we organize an event to bring the team together, fostering camaraderie and mutual understanding.
Competitive Salary: We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. The salary band for this position is between 4500 BRL and 9000 BRL gross per month.
Professional Development Plan: Recognizing the desire for personal growth, we provide guidance and support to our team members on their professional journey.
English Language Lessons: As an international company, we provide support in English language, as well as other languages in cases when it's relevant for the role and the team.
What are the steps of the hiring process?
First interview (30 minutes) with Sofía, People & Culture Specialist, to know each other, know more about the company and our culture, the position and the team, and if your background and aspirations fit the profile.
Second interview (30 minutes) with Ana, our Content Manager, and Ori, our Social Media Team Lead, to get a better understanding of the role's mission and expectation and to verify the fit with the company.
If you are excited about the things that you just read, don't hesitate to apply for the job position

title: Human Factors Engineer- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a Human Factors Engineer to join the Loss Prevention Organization (LP).
LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.
Your primary role is to embed principles of human and organizational factors in operational process and capital projects, promote a sound safety culture, build human factors capability in the company and share human factors knowledge as well as engage with the industry.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Develop corporate policies, guidelines, standards and specifications for human factors.
Develop tools to incorporate human factors in qualitative and quantitative risk assessments (e.g., human failure analysis, safety critical task analysis, human reliability analysis) as well as support risk assessment activities that involve these tools.
Introduce human performance tools to error-proof routine and non-routine field activities, including embedding human factors thinking into the day-to-day activities (e.g., site inspections, work permitting, pre and post job briefings, JSA).
Participate, review and analyze human factors issues in incident investigations.
Advise on Human Factors Engineering (HFE) integration in capital projects, verifying compliance with international and company HFE standards as well as Human-Machine Interface (HMI) specifications.
Streamline critical communications for frontline workers, advising on shift turnover practices, communication interfaces between work group and between organizations.
Advise facilities on how to manage fatigue risk and best practices in shift work schedule design, including safe manning levels, optimal workload and allocation of functions.
Develop programs and strategies for driving and sustaining a positive safety culture, operationalizing proven methods to assess safety culture, and driving targeted interventions.
Develop methods to measure psychological safety and action plans to address areas for improvement.
Identify and lead the deployment of innovative technologies to reduce human failure.
Provide awareness as well as technical training for different human factors topics.
Mentor other LP personnel.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, industrial psychology, human factors, ergonomics, or safety from an Accredited Institution
You will have 7 years of experience as a human factor professional in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including as strong track record in delivering results.
You will hold a recognized certification in human factors such as Certified Human Factors Professional (CHFP), Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE), Chartered Ergonomics and Human Factors Specialist (C.ErgHF), or European Ergonomist (Eur.Erg).
You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Somos movimento, criatividade e história. A Inbrands nasceu em 2008 com um propósito claro: construir um ecossistema de marcas que inspiram pessoas e transformam a moda em experiência.

Não seguimos tendências. Criamos caminhos. Evoluímos com consistência, estratégia e muito trabalho. Somos apaixonados por construir marcas fortes e negócios sustentáveis, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento das pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.
Nosso DNA
Acreditamos que a moda vai além do vestir — ela conecta histórias, expressa identidades e cria relações verdadeiras.
Nosso propósito é inspirar pessoas através da moda e da experiência de marca, com integridade, atitude e paixão por fazer acontecer. Crescemos valorizando aquilo que nunca sai de moda: gente, essência e verdade.

title: SEM Manager
description:
Position is Remote (Canada, or Latin / South America)
No agencies please
Maximus ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine company that empowers individuals to achieve their physical and cognitive peak through precision telehealth care. We are a high-growth, profitable company tailored to ambitious people who refuse to settle for average. We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.
About The Role
We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.
You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that's just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners
Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.
Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.
Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.
Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.
Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.
Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.
Qualifications
Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.
Demand Gen / Youtube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.
Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).
Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.
Nice To Haves
Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.
Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.
Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.
World-Class Benefits
Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility
Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.
Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.
Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people's health and wellness
Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities
Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)
Liquidity of options whenever available
Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.
Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

Experiência prévia em gestão da experiência do cliente;

Here's what we are looking for:
- 7+ years of IT recruiting experience.
- 2+ years of experience managing teams.
- Time management and organizational skills.
- Flexibility and the ability to adapt to constant change.
- Previous experience with online and phone sales techniques (a plus)

title: Corporativo Administrador Operador
description:
Tem vaga nova na área Se você tem interesse em trabalhar no Grupo Habibs, venha cadastrar seu perfil aqui com a gente. Venha fazer parte da maior rede de fast-food genuinamente brasileira. Só vem O que buscamos:Um profissional capaz de garantir a saúde financeira de um conjunto de lojas, a organização dos setores, a gestão de equipe e o cumprimento dos padrões estabelecidos pela franqueadora, promovendo assim, a melhor experiência de consumo aos nossos clientes e assegurando bons resultados ao negócio. Quais serão as suas funções e atividades:Atingir os melhores resultados financeiros da loja por meio da elaboração e acompanhamento do plano de despesas, a fim de reduzir gastos e adequar a alocação de recursos. Garantir que a coluna mestra proporcione uma excelente experiência de consumo aos clientes por meio de um atendimento rápido e cordial e, com bons produtos dentro dos padrões estabelecidos pela Rede. Realizar a gestão e o acompanhamento dos indicadores de resultado e desempenho da loja, buscando ações e soluções que visam o crescimento do TM de cada setor, impactando no aumento de faturamento. Acompanhar controle de estoque da loja, perdas e ganhos dos insumos, vendas qualificadas, visando o resultado final de CMV estabelecido pela Rede. Gerir o fluxo financeiro por meio da administração do capital de giro e das contas a pagar, a fim de manter a saúde financeira da loja. Certificar que as compras estejam em quantidade correta e qualidade adequada, a fim de atender à demanda da loja. Responsável pelo recrutamento e seleção da equipe dos setores cozinha e atendimento. Assegurar que os utensílios, equipamentos e sistemas utilizados estejam em quantidade correta e em bom estado de conservação e funcionamento, providenciando a aquisição, troca ou manutenção, sempre que necessário. Garantir a correta aplicação de recursos nas decisões de investimento, a fim de promover melhorias e adequações aos padrões da franqueadora. Conhecer o cardápio, a composição dos pratos, os acompanhamentos e as campanhas promocionais, buscando atualizações constantes com a Rede e transmitindo os conhecimentos para a equipe de gerência, a fim de garantir o padrão de qualidade de atendimento ao cliente. Assegurar a limpeza e a organização da loja na abertura e fechamento, por meio da equipe de gerência, de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos.
